title: In-Context Black-Box Optimization with Unreliable Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2605.06187v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Black-box optimization in science and engineering often comes with side information: experts, simulators, pretrained predictors, or heuristics can suggest promising candidates. Such feedback can accelerate search, but can also be biased, input-dependent, or misleading. Feedback-aware Bayesian optimization methods typically handle tasks independently, limiting adaptation across feedback sources. In-context optimizers enable cross-task adaptation, but usually rely only on optimization history at test time. We study feedback-informed in-context black-box optimization (FICBO), where a pretrained optimizer conditions on both the observed history and cheap auxiliary feedback for the current candidate set. We introduce structured priors over how auxiliary feedback relates to the objective, and use them to pretrain a feedback-aware transformer across regimes ranging from highly informative to misleading. translated_title: 基于不可靠反馈的上下文黑盒优化
translated_abstract: 科学与工程中的黑盒优化通常伴随着辅助信息：专家、模拟器、预训练预测器或启发式方法可以提出有前景的候选方案。这类反馈能够加速搜索，但也可能存在偏差、依赖于输入或具有误导性。感知反馈的贝叶斯优化方法通常独立处理各个任务，限制了跨反馈源的适应能力；而上下文优化器虽然能够实现跨任务适应，但在测试时通常仅依赖优化历史。我们研究了基于反馈信息的上下文黑盒优化（FICBO），其中预训练的优化器同时以观测历史和当前候选集的廉价辅助反馈为条件。我们引入了关于辅助反馈与目标之间关系的结构化先验，并利用它们在从高度信息丰富到具有误导性的各种情形下预训练一个感知反馈的 Transformer。在测试时，该模型估计……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出反馈感知的上下文黑盒优化框架FICBO，通过结构化先验预训练Transformer，使其能同时利用优化历史和可能不可靠的辅助反馈，从而在反馈质量参差不齐的情况下实现稳健的跨任务优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Feedback-Informed In-Context Black-box Optimization (FICBO), which pretrains a feedback-aware transformer with structured priors to leverage both optimization history and potentially unreliable auxiliary feedback, enabling robust cross-task adaptation regardless of feedback quality.
